title: Community Health Worker
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Community Health Worker  - Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Utilize culturally competent and scientifically accurate health information effectively in verbal and non-verbal communication with individuals and communities.
Demonstrate critical thinking through the application of evidence-based practice in healthcare.

Apply knowledge of public health principles to analyze health outcomes by considering the interplay of biological, sociological, and psychological factors, while recognizing and valuing diversity in health experiences and outcomes
Demonstrate trust-building and capacity-building strategies through the proper dissemination of culturally sensitive health education materials to strengthen community engagement and empowerment.
Demonstrate proficiency in coordinating healthcare services and navigating patients through the healthcare system, ensuring access to necessary services and resources.
